parts.text:

Write one site note per station, in the order given, using exactly this template for each station:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kenpoly-convocation-arena
Curve type: KHK-type
Aquifer depth: 7.92 - 25.9 m
Recommendation: Target the third layer to intercept the identified aquifer.

Station: Maakoro-street
Curve type: KHKH-type
Aquifer depth: 9.16 - 24.4 m
Recommendation: Drill to intercept the third layer for potential water production.

Station: Gokana-street
Curve type: HAA-type
Aquifer depth: N/A
Recommendation: High resistivity values suggest no significant aquifer within the surveyed depth.

Station: Market-road
Curve type: AAA-type
Aquifer depth: 2.86 - 54.6 m
Recommendation: Focus on the moderately conductive layers between 2.86m and 54.6m.

Station: Kogam-street
Curve type: HAA-type
Aquifer depth: 0.82 - 27.7 m
Recommendation: Target the low resistivity zone identified between 0.82m and 27.7m.

Station: Court-road
Curve type: Q-type
Aquifer depth: 62.9 - 114 m
Recommendation: Aim for the deep conductive layer located between 62.9m and 114m.

Station: Kenpoly-sec-school-field
Curve type: KHK-type
Aquifer depth: 11.9 - 27.1 m
Recommendation: Target the third layer to intercept the identified aquifer.

Station: BMGS-bori-field
Curve type: KQHA-type
Aquifer depth: 20.7 - 29.7 m
Recommendation: Drill to intercept the fourth layer between 20.7m and 29.7m.
